story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Logan, and Ava. In a statement by Logan: "if Logan is an altruist then Ava is an egoist". In a statement by Ava: "if Logan is an altruist then Ava is an altruist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "Logan is a altruist/egoist, and Ava is a altruist/egoist")

options: Logan is an egoist, Ava is an egoist
Logan is an altruist, Ava is an egoist
Logan is an altruist, Ava is an altruist
Logan is an egoist, Ava is an altruist
